cards.name: Ampharos
cards.description: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

cards.name: Meganium
cards.description: Meganium's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

cards.name: Meganium
cards.description: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.

cards.name: Pichu
cards.description: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.description: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they are actually hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.

cards.name: Slowking
cards.description: When its head was bitten, toxins entered Slowpoke's head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

cards.name: Steelix
cards.description: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.

cards.name: Togetic
cards.description: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

cards.name: Typhlosion
cards.description: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.

cards.name: Typhlosion
cards.description: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

cards.name: Azumarill
cards.description: By keeping still and listening intently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast-moving rivers.

cards.name: Cleffa
cards.description: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

cards.name: Donphan
cards.description: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its tackle is strong enough to knock down a house.

cards.name: Elekid
cards.description: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it charges up only a little bit.

cards.name: Magby
cards.description: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, hot embers dribble out of its mouth and nostrils.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.description: It is said that when chased, it lures its attacker onto dark mountain trails where the foe will get lost.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.description: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

cards.name: Aipom
cards.description: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.

cards.name: Ariados
cards.description: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It's hard to tell which end is which.

cards.name: Bayleef
cards.description: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

cards.name: Bayleef
cards.description: The scent of spices comes from around its neck. Somehow, sniffing it makes you want to fight.

cards.name: Bellossom
cards.description: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.description: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

cards.name: Croconaw
cards.description: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

cards.name: Croconaw
cards.description: It opens its huge jaws wide when attacking. If it loses any fangs while biting, they grow back in.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.description: Electricity runs across the surface of its body. In darkness, its entire body glows a whitish-blue.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.description: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.

cards.name: Furret
cards.description: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.description: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

cards.name: Granbull
cards.description: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If attacked, it flails about to fend off its attacker.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.description: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.

cards.name: Ledian
cards.description: When the stars flicker in the night sky, Ledian flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.

cards.name: Feraligatr
cards.description: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.description: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suitable for itself.

cards.name: Miltank
cards.description: Its milk is packed with nutrition, making it the ultimate beverage for the sick or weary.

cards.name: Noctowl
cards.description: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

cards.name: Phanpy
cards.description: It swings its long snout around playfully, but, because it is so strong, that can be dangerous.

cards.name: Piloswine
cards.description: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.

cards.name: Quagsire
cards.description: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.

cards.name: Quilava
cards.description: This Pokémon is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

cards.name: Quilava
cards.description: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.

cards.name: Seadra
cards.description: An examination of its cells revealed the presence of a gene not found in Horsea. It became a hot topic.

cards.name: Skiploom
cards.description: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.

cards.name: Feraligatr
cards.description: It is hard for it to support its own weight out of water, so it gets down on all fours. But it moves fast.

cards.name: Sunflora
cards.description: It converts sunlight into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.

cards.name: Togepi
cards.description: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.

cards.name: Xatu
cards.description: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

cards.name: Chikorita
cards.description: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up the sun's rays.

cards.name: Chikorita
cards.description: Its pleasantly aromatic leaf has the ability to check the humidity and temperature.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.description: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.

cards.name: Cyndaquil
cards.description: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.

cards.name: Cyndaquil
cards.description: It is timid and always curls itself up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.

cards.name: Girafarig
cards.description: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent and bite.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.description: It flies straight at its target's face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.description: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies' bellies, then lifts and throws them.

cards.name: Hoothoot
cards.description: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast that the movement can rarely be seen.

cards.name: Hoppip
cards.description: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. They do enjoy gentle breezes, though.

cards.name: Horsea
cards.description: If attacked by a larger enemy, it quickly swims to safety by adeptly controlling its dorsal fin.

cards.name: Ledyba
cards.description: It is very timid. It's afraid to move if alone, but it's active if in a group.

cards.name: Mantine
cards.description: Swimming freely in open seas, it may fly out of the water and over the waves if it builds up enough speed.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.description: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

cards.name: Marill
cards.description: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.

cards.name: Natu
cards.description: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.description: Awakened by moonlight, it roams actively at night. In the day it stays quietly underground.

cards.name: Onix
cards.description: It twists and squirms through the ground. The thunderous roar of its tunneling echoes a long way.

cards.name: Jumpluff
cards.description: Once it catches the wind, it deftly controls its cotton-puff spores to float, even around the world.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

cards.name: Sentret
cards.description: A very cautious Pokémon, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.

cards.name: Shuckle
cards.description: The Berries it stores in its vaselike shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.description: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.description: Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular.

cards.name: Spinarak
cards.description: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

cards.name: Stantler
cards.description: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.description: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears to be closer to a rock than a plant.

cards.name: Sunkern
cards.description: It may drop out of the sky suddenly. If attacked by a Spearow, it violently shakes its leaves.

cards.name: Swinub
cards.description: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

cards.name: Kingdra
cards.description: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.

cards.name: Totodile
cards.description: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

cards.name: Totodile
cards.description: Its well-developed jaws are powerful and capable of crushing anything. Even its trainer must be careful.

cards.name: Wooper
cards.description: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It leaves the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

cards.name: Lugia
cards.description: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea, because its powers are too strong.
